name: spinlog
description: A zero-runtime-dependency, ESM-only terminal feedback library with target-local rendering capped at 10,496 bytes gzipped.
author: spinlog contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:types
scripts.check:phase0: npm run check:phase-map && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run test:phase0 && node scripts/check-phase0.mjs
scripts.check:phase1: npm run check:phase-map && npm run policy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && node scripts/check-phase1.mjs && npm run package:lint && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run pack:check
scripts.check:phase1:release: npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check && node scripts/check-phase1-release.mjs
scripts.check:phase2: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run typecheck:public && npm run api:check && npm run runtime:check && node scripts/check-phase2.mjs && npm run package:lint && npm run check:tree-shaking && npm run test:consumer && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run pack:check
scripts.check:foundation: npm run check:phase0 && npm run check:phase1 && npm run check:phase1:release && npm run check:phase2
scripts.check:phase3: npm run policy:check && npm run build && npm run benchmark:smoke && npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check && npm run sbom:build && npm run sbom:build:check && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run package:lint && npm run pack:check && npm run reproducibility:check && npm run check:baseline-scope && node scripts/check-phase3.mjs
scripts.check:phase4: npm run build && npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check && npm run docs:check && npm run test:examples && npm run pack:check && node scripts/check-phase4.mjs
scripts.check:phase5: npm run check:phase-map && npm run policy:check && npm run sbom:check && npm run pack:check && npm run https:check && node scripts/check-phase5.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run policy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run typecheck:public && npm run api:check && npm run runtime:check && node scripts/check-phase2.mjs && npm run package:lint && npm run check:tree-shaking && npm run test:consumer && npm run size && npm run size:limit && npm run pack:check
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify && npm run sbom && npm run sbom:check
